starting_grade_source: Independent R6 reviewer feedback relayed by the coordinator. Exterior remained repetitive; roof form/height and master placement were uncertain.

changes: Rebuilt the existing 288 representative spectator seat silhouettes from simple blocks into joined, extruded seat-pan and slanted-back profiles with softened edges. The count and layout remain schematic; Purdue publishes a capacity of 625.

Added 18 compact overhead LED diffuser meshes and matching area lights arranged in the modeled pool-hall bays. The lighting contractor's project page supports updated LED lighting above the competition/diving pools; fixture count, position, dimensions, power, and layout are explicitly presentation estimates, not an as-built plan. The area-light shadows are disabled to avoid 18 competing shadow maps in the EEVEE preview.

Added two suspended black-and-gold Purdue display panels with hangers reaching the modeled lower truss zone and text facing outward on both sides. Existing photo references support Purdue-branded display motifs, but banner locations and scale are estimated.

Adjusted the existing 21 schematic steel-truss meshes to a less dominant medium neutral painted-steel finish. The material character is photo-supported; geometry, member sizes, spacing, and elevations remain unverified.
Added an interior integrated-lighting camera and close north-entry camera for review. Render-only roof/context visibility and neutral world changes are restored after the preview renders.
uncertainties: No measured roof section, roof profile, or eave/ridge heights were located. Roof geometry remains unverified.
The light-painted truss material character is photo-supported, while all member dimensions, geometry, spacing, and elevations remain schematic.
The lighting source confirms a building-specific LED installation, not the modeled count, exact fixture placement, dimensions, power, or lighting plan.
Banner count, location, and scale are presentation estimates based on qualitative facility photos.
The modeled 288 spectator seats are representative and do not equal published capacity; exact seating, stand, and circulation arrangement remains uncertain.
Optional site dressing remains separate, approximate, and un-georeferenced.
GIS-to-shell correspondence validates local footprint outline only. Campus-master placement and survey accuracy remain unverified.
